anomalies.observed: The 3.3V LDO output (REG3 pins 1 and 2) is on net +3.3V, while the MCU/connector rail is on net +3V3. The two nets share no nodes in the netlist.
anomalies.expected: A single 3.3V rail should connect the LDO output to both MCUs and all I2C sensor ICs, as the specification states 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC and NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs.

anomalies.impact: The MCU/connector rail +3V3 receives no power from the LDO, so the MCUs, SWD/UART connectors, and associated pull-ups are unpowered.

anomalies.observed: All VDD power input pins of FCC2 and NAVC2 are on unconnected nets. NAVC2 VSS pins 18 and 63 are connected only to each other on Net-(NAVC2-VSS-Pad18), not to GND.
anomalies.expected: MCU VDD pins should connect to the 3.3V rail; VSS pins should connect to GND.

anomalies.expected: NAVC should be master of the sensor I2C bus, so its I2C pins should connect to NET0030 and NET0074.
